action: The howl erupts from the centre: a crimson shock ring bursts outward, then a second and third ring follow, screaming prai ghost faces streak outward with the waves and dissolve at the rim, violet flames flare up around the outer ring and smoke billows outward along the ground, embers scatter, then the waves fade and only drifting smoke and a few embers remain. Stay flat on the ground as an ellipse, centre stays empty, same palette, transparent background.
seedPrompt: TERRORIZE HOWL spell VFX for a classic elevated three-quarter MMORPG view: a violent spirit HOWL SHOCKWAVE bursting outward from an empty centre, lying flat on the ground as a wide horizontal ELLIPSE (about twice as wide as tall). Several jagged concentric crimson-red shock rings, between them screaming pale-violet prai ghost faces with stretched open mouths and trailing wispy bodies flying outward in every direction, tall licking violet-purple spirit flames bursting up along the outer ring, thick dark violet smoke billowing outward low along the ground, crimson embers and small purple sparks thrown outward. The very centre is an empty calm space for the caster. Terrifying, dramatic and grand but not gore, no skulls, no blood, no pentagram, no Western runes, no readable script, no character, no floor texture, no text. Crimson red, deep purple, violet fire, dark violet smoke, pale bone-violet ghost highlights, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, transparent background, at least 8 pixels of empty margin on every side.
